reactions.name: CO_OH_M
reactions.__description: CO + OH + M -> CO2 + HO2 + M, termolecular branch of CO + OH from JPL 15-10, as used in CAM mechanisms before Dec 2022 (CAM tag cam6_3_000, pp_trop_strat_mam4_ts2/chem_mech.in: [CO_OH_M] 5.9e-33, 1, 1.1e-12, -1.3, 0.6). Used with usr_CO_OH_b in place of the JPL 19-5 combined usr_CO_OH rate.

reactions.name: usr_CO_OH_b
reactions.__description: CO + OH -> CO2 + H, chemical-activation branch of CO + OH from JPL 15-10, as computed in CAM mo_usrrxt.F90 usr_CO_OH_b (mechanisms before Dec 2022): k0 = 1.5e-13 cm3 molec-1 s-1, k_inf = 2.1e9 (T/300)^6.1 s-1, Fc = 0.6. Used with CO_OH_M in place of the JPL 19-5 combined usr_CO_OH rate.
